points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake and a prior build artifact exist; no clean build rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: CLI parser/source documented; malformed-input execution not rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated mesh, partition, solver, implicit, transient, output modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal executable-wrapper evidence was found; trust policy prohibits external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case parsing and CGNS mesh path input; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS and neighbor exchange/reductions present; output limitation acknowledged.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Divergent and nonphysical viscous cases show poor robustness.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Some MPI evidence; final results fail and no clean evaluator run.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Reasonably modular source; helper has absolute legacy paths.
